items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to conformity, normative and informational influence, and Asch's line study.

items.title: Social Influence — Conformity (AQA A-Level Psychology)
items.description: Podcast episode walking through types of conformity and the factors that strengthen or weaken it — good exam-prep listening.

items.title: Asch Conformity Experiment (original footage)
items.description: Original footage of Asch's line-judgment study showing confederates giving wrong answers and the naive participant's reaction.

items.title: Solomon Asch — Conformity Experiment
items.description: Clear educational breakdown of Asch's procedure, findings, and conclusions, ideal for GCSE revision.

items.title: Social Influence: Crash Course Psychology #38
items.description: Crash Course episode covering conformity, obedience, and group influence — a lively overview of the whole Social Influence unit.

items.title: The Stanford Prison Experiment (2015)
items.description: Dramatisation of Zimbardo's 1971 experiment, showing how assigned roles create powerful conformity pressures in a simulated prison.

items.title: The Stanford Prison Experiment — Vsauce
items.description: Vsauce deep-dive into the Stanford Prison Experiment and what it reveals about how social roles shape conformity and behaviour.

items.title: BBC Bitesize — AQA GCSE Psychology
items.description: BBC Bitesize hub for AQA GCSE Psychology with revision notes, videos and quizzes covering all topics including Social Influence.

items.title: AQA GCSE Psychology specification
items.description: Official AQA spec page — useful for checking exactly what you need to know about conformity and Asch for the exam.
